title: Who is the greatest?
description: In Capernaum, Jesus asks his disciples what they were discussing on the way, and they remain silent because they had argued about who was the greatest. Jesus teaches them that whoever wants to be first must be last and a servant of all, and he places a child among them. He warns against causing little ones who believe in him to stumble and urges them to remove anything that leads to sin. Finally, he speaks about being salted with fire and keeping peace with one another.
